"Love, Learn and Thrive"
Welcome to Ticehurst and Flimwell Church of England Primary School
"Love, Learn and Thrive"
Ticehurst and Flimwell is a compassionate, safe and supportive community which encourages all to serve and respect one another, to grow together with God's love, in the pursuit of a virtuous life.
Through our Christian virtues, we persevere, learning from our mistakes in the quest for wisdom and our mission to thrive and ultimately flourish.
"I have come that they may have life and have it to the full." John 10:10
Welcome from the Head of School: Mrs Debbie Rofe
A warm welcome to Ticehurst and Flimwell CE Primary School.
We do hope that you find the school's website informative and a celebration of the life and work of our school. As a Church of England school, our aspiration is to shape individuals, families and communities so that the individual worth of each person is nurtured and celebrated as we strive together to "Love, Learn and Thrive".
Our vision is to develop an ethos with an orientation to 'life in all it's fullness', enabled by an education that embraces excellence where all our children can flourish.
Thank you for your interest in joining our community, we invite you to come and visit us so that you can sense the support of our family orientated and loving school. You are very welcome at any time.
Tours for Prospective families:
Please contact the school office on 01580 200344 or email ticehurstoffice@bewlfederation.org to book. Come and see our lovely school in action. We look forward to meeting you.
Telephone: 01580 200344
Email : ticehurstoffice@bewlfederation.org
Address: Steellands Rise, Ticehurst, Wadhurst, East Sussex, TN5 7DH
Upcoming Key Dates
Happy birthday Sir David Attenborough!
Telephone: 01580 200344 E-mail: office@ticehurst.e-sussex.sch.uk

pageCache.text:
Wrap Around Care
To book, please click here or email tandfwraparound@bewlfederation.org.
Breakfast and After School Club
Our dedicated Wrap Around space enables our staff to provide high quality on site care at the beginning and end of the day in a fun and relaxed family friendly environment.
Our wrap around care provides children with a soft and welcoming start to the day; they develop a strong sense of belonging in a nurturing, family friendly environment.
As we are now all on one site, children can attend any of our extra-curricular clubs before joining After School Club in the Wrap Around building.
Breakfast Club operates daily from 8.00am to 8.45am. The first 15 minutes is charged at £2.50 whilst 8.15am to 8.45am is free as we are part of the DfE funded programme.
After School Club operates from 3.15pm to 4.45pm on a Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. This is charged at £8 per session.

English
“From the day our children are born, to the day they tell us to stop, we should read to them".
Principles of Great English Teaching
At Ticehurst and Flimwell we are implementing Literacy Tree, which is a completely book based approach which is based around a "Teach around the Text" pedagogy. This has restructured our delivery of the English curriculum and works in alignment with the Principles of our whole school Teaching and Learning pedagogy.
There is a culture that app children can succeed in becoming confident proficient readers and writers with a love of language, literature and the spoken word.

Geography
"Geography is, in the broadest sense, an education for life and for living. Learning through geography – whether gained through formal learning or experientially through travel, fieldwork and expeditions – helps us all to be more socially and environmentally sensitive, better informed, and more responsible as citizens.
Geography puts the understanding of social and physical processes within the context of place - recognising the great differences in cultures, political systems, economies, landscapes and environments across the world, and exploring the links between them. Understanding the causes of differences and inequalities between places and social groups underlie much of the newer developments in human geography."
Royal Geographical Society
